I am the CEO and LPT of a vibrant, innovative approach to pediatric physical therapy. 

Free to Move and Play provides evidence-based therapeutic techniques to help children achieve their highest potential for mobility and development. We believe pediatric services that promote innovative play create life-changing outcomes for both your child and family. We currently serve kids ages 3months - 5 years old!

After thirty years of Physical Therapy experience in different settings with fourteen years in pediatrics, I’m thrilled to finally bring the vision of Free To Move and Play to life. My desire is to create a treatment environment that will capture and maintain a child’s attention by keeping the therapy process as fun as possible. I’m passionate about equipping parents to become daily “therapists” so they feel empowered to help their child achieve their highest potential at home and within the familiar fabric of their communities.
